1 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] Weighted minimum bound: let p_1, ..., p_m be positive reals with sum_i p_i = 1 and let n_1, ..., n_m be real numbers; then min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] The index set {1, ..., m} is finite and nonempty, so the minimum n_k := min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i is attained at some index k in {1, ..., m}.
  1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, n_k <= n_i.
  1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, p_i * n_k <= p_i * n_i.
  1.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k * sum_i p_i.
  1.6 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k * sum_i p_i = n_k, since sum_i p_i = 1.
  1.7 [[33mpending[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.7.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k.
    1.7.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
    1.7.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k * sum_i p_i and n_k * sum_i p_i = n_k both hold.
    1.7.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k.
    1.7.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] The left-hand side of the established inequality sum_i p_i * n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i may be replaced by n_k.
    1.7.6 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
      1.7.6.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
        1.7.6.1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] General substitution principle for order relations: for real numbers a, b, c, if a = b and a <= c, then b <= c.
        1.7.6.1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
        1.7.6.1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i, obtained by rewriting the left-hand side of the inequality sum_i p_i * n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i using the equality sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k.
      1.7.6.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i, obtained by rewriting the left-hand side of sum_i p_i * n_k <= sum_i p_i * n_i using the equality sum_i p_i * n_k = n_k.
  1.8 [[32mvalidated[0m/[33munresolved[0m] min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
